newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Shorewood Packaging begun with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Shorewood Packaging begun with buy.

text.p: -- Sands Brothers & Co Ltd said Friday it has begun coverage of Shorewood Packaging with a strong buy rating, citing expected strong growth in cash flow, valuation, expected expansion into China and other factors.
--Estimated fiscal 1997 earnings are $1.30 a share, compared to $1.03 in fiscal 1996, analyst Matthew Russo wrote in a research report.
--The stock is trading at a hefty discount to its earnings growth rate, Russo wrote. The stock was unchanged at 18-5/8 Friday. Russo's six-month price target is 25.

--"We believe the company can improve its EBITDA (cash flow) 20 percent to about $67 million in fiscal 1997 from $56 million in 1996," Russo wrote, noting operational efficiencies being implemented, new cooperative programs with key suppliers and the stabilization of paperboard prices.
